en.title: Minimum Cost to Select People for Skill Quotas
en.description:
Each person has a non-negative cost and two skill flags. For K=1..n, find the minimum cost so that at least K people have skill 1 and at least K people have skill 2; a person with both skills counts toward both sides; output −1 if infeasible.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), followed by n lines of cost skill1 skill2. cost is 0..10⁹, and skills are 0/1. Non-negative costs are site-added; answers use 64-bit integers.
en.output: Output the minimum cost or −1 for K=1..n in order.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
